notes: Fresh browser session created and closed/reopened before the run.
Only VAL-Q-006 and VAL-AN-004 were exercised in this rerun.
Evidence path was reused only as a destination; screenshots were captured fresh for this run.

assertions.title: Queue loading skeleton is visibly rendered on reload or tab switch
steps: Signed into http://app.localhost:3000/auth/signin with the provided Old Crown credentials and navigated to /email-delivery.
Opened the Queue tab, then captured immediate and settled screenshots after a full page reload on ?tab=queue.
Switched Delivery Log -> Queue again and captured immediate and settled screenshots to look for a visible loading skeleton.

Observed queue summary and filter controls but no visible skeleton placeholders in either immediate or settled captures; only a Supabase auth fetch was visible in tracked network requests after reload.
issues: No visible loading skeleton rendered during fresh reload or Delivery Log -> Queue tab switch in this run.
Tracked network observability after reload only showed a Supabase auth request, so queue fetch timing could not be directly observed from the browser tool output.

assertions.title: Analytics loads independently after switching from a page-2+ delivery log state
steps: Returned to Delivery Log and verified the live dataset showed 'Showing 1-1 of 1 results' with disabled Prev and Next controls.
Attempted to satisfy the page-2+ precondition on the real authenticated surface, but the UI exposed only a single result and no enabled pagination path beyond page 1.
Captured a fresh Delivery Log screenshot, then switched to Analytics and captured immediate and settled screenshots after the tab change.
Confirmed the Analytics view rendered its range controls after the switch, but the required page-2+ Delivery Log precondition could not be met on the live dataset in this rerun.
issues: Page-2+ precondition was impossible to satisfy on the real surface because the Delivery Log had only one result and disabled pagination controls.
Analytics did render after switching tabs, but this rerun cannot fully pass the contract because the required starting state was unavailable.

frictions: Post-login redirected to /dashboard rather than directly to /email-delivery, so the flow had to navigate manually to the Email Delivery page.
The agent-browser network request log provided limited request history for app data, which constrained direct timing evidence beyond the observed UI states.
summary: Fresh authenticated rerun completed for VAL-Q-006 and VAL-AN-004 only. VAL-Q-006 failed because no visible queue loading skeleton appeared on reload or tab switch. VAL-AN-004 failed because the live Delivery Log dataset exposed only page 1 with disabled pagination, although Analytics still rendered after tab switching.
